What we do

Property services

From seasonal cleanup to tough outdoor jobs, Midwest Grit is ready to help homeowners take care of their properties.

Snow Removal

Driveway and walkway clearing to help keep your property accessible through Wisconsin winters.

Junk Removal

Hauling away unwanted household items, clutter, and general property junk.

Gutter Cleaning

Clear leaves and debris from gutters to help water drain away properly.

Yard Cleanup

Seasonal cleanup, brush and debris pickup, and general outdoor tidying.

Pressure Washing

Exterior cleaning for suitable driveways, walkways, siding, and outdoor surfaces.

Lawn Mowing

Reliable mowing to keep your yard neat and maintained through the growing season.

Garbage Bin Cleaning

Help remove built-up grime and odors from residential garbage and recycling bins.

Small Demolition

Help with small, non-structural tear-out and removal projects. Scope reviewed before work begins.
